create_scicite_dataset: create a SciCite classification dataset instance for citation intent classification
load_scicite_dataset: load the SciCite dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input text and label tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits for the SciCite dataset with a given seed
run_scicite_preprocessing: run the main function to generate 16-shot data for multiple random seeds
